main_text.p: Iam reprimere, ipse non tantum efflore-scentem iuuenilem effrenationem inhibuit, sed laudibus euehens, & ad facta, quorum etiam aures a commemoratione abhorrent, promouit, & potissimum eum, qui profitetur se, etiam Deum testans, toto animo abhorrere ab isto more conuicijs aduersarios profcindendi. Sed non mirum. Opponens Aspidis Coruiqué ouum est, foetus compar parenti. τὸ πατρὸς ἐξ[?] τῷ παιδίον[?] Hinc ille; Tum si quis magistrum capit ad eam rem improbum, ipsum animum agrotum ad deteriorem partem adplicat.
main_text.head: CAPVT XIV. De Ecclesijs Eois aliys, vt conueniant cum Reformatis, & de eorum cum Ecclesia Romana consensu, Epistola Abrahami Ecchellensis ad Leonem Allatium, Bibliotheca Vaticana Præfectum.
main_text.p: Sed adhuc perstat in prauitate, & perstrepit Hottingerus; habere se multa, quæ confessioni Græcorum ab Allatio adhornatæ opponat. Sed dignam esse materiâ, quæ plenius pertractetur. Interim ex Topographia Ecclesiastica, ex Symbolicis Syrorum, Arabum, Aethiopum, Coptitarum, quibus manifestum esse

page.notes: The Greek phrase after "foetus compar parenti." is only partly legible; the letters marked [?] are uncertain. The reading of the first Greek word is doubtful. "Coruiqué" is probably "Coruique" with an abbreviation mark; the printed form was not clear enough to confirm. The line "esse" at the end of the page is set indented on the right and is the last line of the paragraph, not a new paragraph. Left edge shows part of the neighbouring page and was not transcribed.
